name: DKCTF Hard Mode – Try 9 P2 selector + symmetric death/respawn
notes: Combined Try 9 plus structurally verified Try 10. Try 9 remains unchanged through its active parser. Try 10 redirects the Hard-mode Item-3 initialization at 0x1E7520 into the previously unreachable Try-9 NOP tail at 0x352804. If GameState+0x26A0 bit 1 is clear, the helper exactly reproduces the stock solo Item-3 capacity=0 call. If bit 1 is set by Try 9, it sets P2 health Item 3 capacity/count to 1. This restores the normal multiplayer invariant used by CPlayerRespawnGOC::OnAction_NotifyOfPlayerDeath. Structural validation complete; in-game death/revive behavior still requires testing.
